QuestInfo.name: On Alchemy, Smithing, and Accessories
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Dello about Alchemy, Smithing, and Accessory Crafting.
QuestInfo.1: Which profession would you like to learn, Alchemy, Smithing, or Accessory Crafting?
QuestInfo.2: You've learned the profession of your choice.

0.0: Zero, did you know that there are many professions in Maple World? Herbalism and Mining are two key professions that go with crafting.\r\nHow about taking up a crafting #bprofession#k?

yes.0:
Are you ready to pick up a new #bprofession#k?
Hobbies like this can help you grow in new ways.
Now, let me give you the rundown.
Talk to me again when #byou're ready to listen#k.

no.0: Let me know if you want to learn more about Smithing, Accessory Crafting, or Alchemy.

yes.0: #bSmithing#k is for crafting equipment, #bAccessory Crafting#K is for crafting accessories, and #bAlchemy#k is for concocting potions.\r\nYour #rFatigue Points#k AND #rMastery#k will both increase when you craft something.
yes.1: If you #btake my class#k, you can raise the #rMastery#k level of a Profession.\n\rYou can also accumulate Mastery through #bProduction#k. Production can be done #rin front of the Ardentmill's production tools#k or #rnear the Cabinet#k inside the temple.
